subject: Urgent: Monday onsite brief — potential pivot to virtual
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@horizoncap.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@horizoncap.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:05:12 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Monday onsite brief — potential pivot to virtual

Markus / Lauren —

Quick heads up: heavy storms have shut down Metro City airport and our CEO's flight has been diverted. Unfortunately it looks increasingly unlikely he'll make it back in time for the Monday morning onsite briefing at your offices.

We really want to avoid cancelling — would Redwood be able to pivot the executive portion to a remote session instead? The priorities for us are:
- 30–45 minute executive briefing (CEO + two SVPs)
- concurrent breakout with product/engineering for the extended team
- ability to share the deck and run a short live Q&A

We attached the current logistics ICS and our onboarding questionnaire in case helpful (logistics_ics.ics, onboard_questionnaire.pdf). If you can run a remote exec format and maintain the breakouts, we can confirm final participants and shift the calendar. If not, can we explore a same-day afternoon slot?

Appreciate the quick reply — Tom and I are on standby.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Strategic Accounts
Horizon Capital
olivia.park@horizoncap.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@horizoncap.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@horizoncap.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Monday onsite brief — potential pivot to virtual

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for letting us know and sorry to hear about the disruption. We can absolutely pivot to a virtual-first format on Monday; we run these remote exec sessions frequently. Proposed approach:

1) Move the executive briefing to a 30–40 minute Zoom meeting (we'll host) — we have capacity at the original start time or 30 min later if you prefer.
2) We'll run concurrent breakout rooms for product/engineering demos; Redwood engineers can staff both the exec and breakout rooms to keep continuity.
3) We will share an updated exec deck (attached: exec_briefing_deck_v3.pdf) and will provide a single-page one-pager for the CEO during the briefing.

Can you confirm: preferred start time (original or +30m), whether CEO will join for full 30–40 minutes, and list of attendees (we just need names/titles so we can set breakout rooms)?

Zoom link (temporary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=execbrief
I'll loop Lauren for logistics and Dylan to handle run-of-show / tech check.

If virtual won't work we can look at the same-day afternoon option, but we recommend keeping the originally planned content and running it remotely to avoid losing momentum.

–Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@horizoncap.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@horizoncap.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:33:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Monday onsite brief — potential pivot to virtual

Markus —

Thanks, that sounds perfect. CEO can join remotely but needs to shift the start 30 minutes later to accommodate travel from the diverted airport. Please hold 10:30 AM local as the new start (was 10:00).

Confirmed attendees for exec briefing:
- Jenna Park, CEO
- Luis Martell, CFO
- Priya Nambiar, SVP Product
Additional 12 people will join the breakout sessions (we'll send the list by EOD).

We'll also share a short note to all participants asking them to dial in 10 minutes early for audio checks. Appreciate you hosting the Zoom.

Olivia
